mapper.select: select count(*) from `approval_record` where `event_id` = #{eventId} and `event_type` = 1 and `apply_type` = 0 and `status` = 0
select `id`, `event_id`, `approve_time`, `proposer_id`, `status` from `approval_record` where `event_id` = #{eventId} and `event_type` = 0 order by `crt_time` desc limit 1
select count(*) from `approval_record` where `event_id` = #{eventId} and `event_type` = 0 and `status` = 1
select count(*) from `approval_record` where `event_id` = #{eventId} and `event_type` = 1 and `apply_type` = 1 and `status` = 1

select `id`, `event_id`, `approve_time`, `dead_time`, `proposer_id` from `approval_record` where `event_id` = #{treatmentId} and `event_type` = 1 and `apply_type` = 0 and `status` = 1 and dead_time >= date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d')

select `id`, `event_id`, `approve_time`, `dead_time`, `status` from `approval_record` where `event_id` = #{medicalId} and `event_type` = 1 and `apply_type` = 1 and `status` = 1 order by `approve_time` desc limit 1

select sum(status = 0) as pendingCount, sum(status = 1 and dead_time >= date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d')) as passCount from `approval_record` where `event_id` = #{eventId} and `event_type` = 1 and `apply_type` = #{applyType}
select count(*) from `approval_record` where `event_id` = #{treatmentId} and `event_type` = 1 and `status` in (0,1)

select `ar1`.`event_id` from `approval_record` `ar1` left join `approval_record` `ar2` on `ar1`.`event_id` = `ar2`.`event_id` where `ar2`.`apply_type` = 0 and `ar1`.`crt_id` = #{loginUserId} and `ar1`.`event_type` = 0 and to_days(`ar1`.`crt_time`) = to_days(#{submitTime}) and 1 > ( select count(*) from `approval_record` where `event_id` = `ar1`.`event_id` and `crt_time` > `ar1`.`crt_time` ); order by ar1.status asc, ar2.crt_time desc
